findings.summary: draft.clientAnswersSavedAt is omitted when there is no client date, while IF-011 specifies `draft.clientAnswersSavedAt | null` (key present, null value).
findings.detail: historyService.ts toDraft (~L243-254) spreads clientAnswersSavedAt only when non-null. src/api/historyApi.ts declares it optional (`clientAnswersSavedAt?: string | null`). The unit's own test asserts absence (tests/api/questionnaireRoutes.test.ts ~L677 uses `?? null`, so it tolerates both). The exact-object tests tests/api/historyRoutes.test.ts (~L231-244, toEqual on the open draft) would fail if the key were always present; that file is outside this unit's file list and inside the Done-when, so the unit cannot change the shape without a correction outside its boundary. Functionally the frontend reads it with `?? null`, so behaviour is correct; the deviation is in the declared shape. Integration should update historyRoutes.test.ts and drop the optional marker, as the implementer proposed.

findings.summary: ConsultantHomeView.awaitingQuestionnaires is omitted when empty, while IF-008 lists `awaitingQuestionnaires[]` as a consultant home field.
findings.detail: portfolioService.ts buildPortfolio (~L300-303) assigns the key only when awaiting.length > 0. The unit's tests assert `toBeUndefined()` for the empty case (tests/api/questionnaireRoutes.test.ts ~L580, L629, L649), so the omission is locked in by this unit's own file. The exact-object test tests/api/homeRoutes.test.ts (~L653-668, toEqual on the empty consultant view) is outside the unit's file list and inside the Done-when; an always-present [] would break it. Consumers must read `awaitingQuestionnaires ?? []`. Integration should update homeRoutes.test.ts (add `awaitingQuestionnaires: []`), drop the optional marker, and flip the three toBeUndefined assertions, as the implementer proposed.
